name: Outer Banks: The Official Podcast
overview: In this new Netflix original podcast, host Ria Ciuffo (Chicks in the Office) sits down with Outer Banks stars Chase Stokes (aka John B), Madelyn Cline (Sarah Cameron), Carlacia Grant (Cleo Anderson), Jonathan Daviss (Pope Heyward), and Madison Bailey (Kiara Carrera) to celebrate the series’ five-season run. Over six episodes, the cast breaks down the show’s biggest moments, including romantic revelations, spectacular stunts, and tragic twists. They also share the inside scoop about their strong on-set bonds, unforgettable fan experiences, and adventures around the globe. Plus, the actors bid an official farewell to Outer Banks after seven years of hard work and discuss the lasting impact of this cultural phenomenon.
